name: CustomShellHost.exe
description: A host process that is used by custom shells when using Windows in Kiosk mode.
author: Wietze Beukema

commands.description: Executes explorer.exe (with command-line argument /NoShellRegistrationCheck) if present in the current working folder.
commands.usecase: Can be used to evade defensive counter-measures

detection: CustomShellHost.exe is unlikely to run on normal workstations
